description: Sismicité en Provence Alpes Côte d'Azur is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by batrame-paca.fr. Since 22 October 2010, France has had a new seismic zoning dividing the national territory into five zones of increasing seismicity (Articles R.563-1 to R.563-8 of the Environmental Code, as amended by Decree No 2010-1254 of 22 October 2010, and Article D.563-8-1 of the Environmental Code, created by Decree No 2010-1255 of 22 October 2010):. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Seismicity in Provence Alpes Côte d’Azur" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include zonage, données ouvertes, risque/séisme. The listing shows 2022-01-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
